messages.author: 022b3a4e8303f469
messages.subject: Issue with using Sadeh algorithm
parts:
Hi!
I am trying to use GGIR Sadeh algorithm for sleep analysis. I added the arguments to my GGIR shell : do.angley=TRUE,
               HASIB.algo = "Sadeh1994",
               Sadeh_axis = "Y"

But I got Errors and warnings like -
Part 3
RData$message

[1] "object 'BrondCount' not found"

$call

HASIB(HASIB.algo = params_sleep[["HASIB.algo"]], timethreshold = params_sleep[["timethreshold"]],

    anglethreshold = params_sleep[["anglethreshold"]],

    time = time, anglez = anglez, ws3 = ws3, zeroCrossingCount = zeroCrossingCount,

    BrondCount = BrondCount)

_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

 Part 4

 1Error in readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE) : cannot open the connection

In addition: Warning message:

In readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE) :

  cannot open compressed file '...../meta/ms3.out/NA', probable reason 'No such file or directory'


Did anyone by any chance have similar issues or know if I need to adjust any other argument? Could you please give me some suggestions?
Thank you so much!
Best,
Xinting Yu

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Issue with using Sadeh algorithm
parts:
Please add argument do.brondcounts = TRUE to g.shell.GGIR.

Sorry, it should be able to work without this and I will fix it, but for now add this argument.

Vincent


Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
